title: DM delivery enables feature flags on shipping project

questions.question: A task that introduced a 'Cycle Runner: no' feature flag just passed QA and is pending-ship. What must DM do with the flag during delivery?
questions.expected: DM must enable it on this project by running 'python references/scripts/config.py set cycle-runner yes'. The flag defaults to no for other installs via upgrade, but the shipping project should always have it enabled.

questions.question: How does DM know which feature flags a shipped task introduced?
questions.expected: DM searches the task body and Discussion comments for feature flag references — config field names like 'Cycle Runner', 'PR Flow', etc.

questions.question: A task ships but does NOT introduce any feature flags. What does DM do at step 4 of delivery?
questions.expected: Nothing — step 4 only applies when the task introduced a feature flag. If no flags are found in the task body or Discussion, DM skips this step.
